meta.title: Topics: what Lisa is there for
meta.description: Relationships, grief, family and caring, work, transitions, overload, personal development – Lisa accompanies you in everyday life.

topics.title: What Lisa is there for.
topics.lead: For the moments when a conversation would help.
topics.note: Orientation in everyday life – not medical treatment and not a substitute for psychotherapy.

items.title: Relationships
items.start: These days we only talk about logistics.
items.ask: Which needs or expectations might be involved?
items.step: Write down the first sentence for that conversation.

items.title: Grief
items.start: Since my husband died, so much has been left undone.
items.ask: What would help you in this moment?
items.step: Decide on a first organisational step. Just one.

items.title: Family and caring
items.start: There is hardly anything left for me.
items.ask: What resources are available to you?
items.step: Plan one hour this week – just for yourself.

items.title: Work
items.start: Since the restructuring I don’t know where I stand.
items.ask: What is particularly important to you here?
items.step: Ask your manager for that conversation.

items.title: Transitions
items.start: The children have left home. What now?
items.ask: Could there be another way to view the situation?
items.step: Write two options down side by side.

items.title: Overload
items.start: Right now it is simply all too much.
items.ask: What are you noticing in yourself?
items.step: Name the one thing that matters today.

items.title: Personal development
items.start: I want to decide more clearly – and doubt less.
items.ask: What options can you already see?
items.step: Pause once a day and notice what is there.

meta.title: Lisa – the AI life companion
meta.description: Lisa is a digital conversational partner: she listens, asks, remembers and helps you find a concrete next step.

lisa.title: She listens.
lisa.lead: A digital conversational partner for your everyday life – in entirely natural language.
lisa.opening: Hello, it’s lovely to see you. How are you today?

traits.title: Listens.
traits.text: A conversation, not a questionnaire and not a programme.

traits.title: Asks.
traits.text: Targeted questions instead of ready-made advice.

traits.title: Remembers.
traits.text: Up to 100 conversations – with your consent. You never have to tell it twice.

traits.title: Stays concrete.
traits.text: Every conversation ends with an achievable step.

lisa.accessTitle: In your browser. Soon on the move.
lisa.accessText: At launch on a laptop or computer. Smartphone access is planned.
lisa.note: Lisa is an AI, not a human being.

meta.title: The method: Talk. Reflect. Act.

meta.description: Answers about Lisa, how it works, personal memory, pricing and availability.

items.q: Is Lisa a form of therapy?
items.a: No. Lisa offers orientation in everyday life. She makes no diagnoses and replaces neither psychotherapy nor medical help.

items.q: What if I am in a very bad place?
items.a: Then Lisa is not the right service. In acute danger in Germany, please call 112. The TelefonSeelsorge can be reached free of charge on 0800 111 0 111.

items.q: Am I talking to a human being?
items.a: No. Lisa is an AI avatar. The conversation methodology behind her has been developed professionally.
